description: This file defines a layout component for a dynamic 'defects' edit page in a Next.js project, including a static parameter generator function for static site generation with dynamic routing.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Provides static parameters for Next.js static export to support dynamic segment routing by returning an empty array, indicating no specific static params.
